recognize_zh: 成群的漿細胞具偏心圓核、核周淡染區與藍色細胞質，細胞質內充滿紫紅色、細長針狀的包涵物（Auer rod-like inclusions），部分細胞核可見核仁，是顆粒豐富的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of medium to large plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; some nuclei show a visible nucleolus (immature/plasmablastic features)
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in several cells
Numerous slender, needle- or rod-shaped azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods
Occasional binucleate plasma cell; background red cells and a neutrophil
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, moderately coarse chromatin, occasional nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Many cells contain numerous slender azurophilic rod-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions that mimic Auer rods, likely representing crystallized immunoglobulin or abnormal lysosomal granules. The cells retain plasmacytic features (eccentric nucleus, perinuclear hof) and lack myeloblast morphology. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and no perinuclear hof, and are MPO-positive, whereas these cells are CD138-positive plasma cells.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei with bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) and strong MPO, not eccentric nuclei with plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Crystals in CSH lie within histiocytes with bland oval nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm rather than within plasma cells.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells are macrophages with wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm, not plasma cells with discrete rod inclusions.
